title: Programming with Cursor via MCP
description: Configures Astloom for software engineering teams that connect Cursor IDE through MCP. Client surface is mcp-lazy style (mcp_search_tools / mcp_execute_tool only on tools/list). Explore-first: prefer astloom_code_graph_explore before wide Read/Grep; also memory, docs drift/write, tasks, and durable project writes.

tools.name: astloom_ping
tools.description: Confirm MCP connectivity and return active usage profile metadata for this project.

tools.name: astloom_get_effective_profile
tools.description: Return the effective Usage Profile (domain pack, feature profile, connectors, MCP tools) for the scoped project.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_explore
tools.description: PRIMARY code-graph tool: answer how/X works or flows with one call — seeds + call path + budgeted source (sibling skeletonization). Prefer this over wide Read/Grep.

query.description: Natural-language or symbol terms (e.g. login auth flow)

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_hybrid_search
tools.description: Hybrid lexical + semantic search merged with Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_detect_changes
tools.description: Risk-scored review context for changed files: affected flows, test gaps, review priorities.

changed_files.description: Repo-relative or absolute paths that changed

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_architecture_overview
tools.description: Communities, hubs, bridges, knowledge gaps, surprising connections, and suggested architecture questions.

tools.name: astloom_memory_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve current-state memory hints for a programming task (maps to memory retrieval capability).

tools.name: astloom_context_compress
tools.description: Native Astloom context compression (Headroom-inspired, clean-room): shrink large JSON/text, store original under a tenant-scoped TTL handle for retrieve. Prefer for bulky tool/RAG blobs before LiteLLM — not a substitute for code-graph tools.

payload.description: Raw text or JSON string to compress

ttl_seconds.description: TTL for stored original when compression runs

tools.name: astloom_context_retrieve
tools.description: Retrieve the original payload for a handle from astloom_context_compress (same tenant/workspace/project scope).

tools.name: astloom_context_stats
tools.description: Process-local native context-compression counters: calls, chars saved, percent reduced, store entries. Use after compress calls on this MCP gateway; CLI equivalent: astloom context stats / measure.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_search
tools.description: Semantic search over the code-knowledge graph (Neo4j when configured) for symbols relevant to a programming query.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_get_symbol
tools.description: Fetch one code-graph symbol by symbol_id or qualified_name (includes AI documentation fields).

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_neighbors
tools.description: Return STRUCTURAL graph neighbors (CALLS/IMPORTS/…) for a symbol (reference_kind=structural). For IDE-precise find-references use astloom_code_graph_ide_references.

rel_type.description: Optional edge type filter, e.g. CALLS

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_impact
tools.description: Directed multi-hop impact / blast radius around a symbol (upstream callers, downstream callees, or both). Prefer before wide file reads. Includes escalate_hint.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_callers
tools.description: Ranked inbound callers (fan-in) for a symbol. Prefer for 'who calls X' before Grep. Includes escalate_hint.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_community
tools.description: Leiden/Louvain community membership for one symbol (label, size, members). Prefer for module-boundary questions.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_call_path
tools.description: Compact outbound call-path pack from a seed symbol (CALLS/HTTP_CALLS/ASYNC_CALLS). Prefer for 'what does X call' before wide Grep. Includes escalate_hint.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_unused_candidates
tools.description: Scored dead-code candidates from the code graph (numeric score, evidence, finding_kind). Includes unwired_shared_package for backend/packages trees with recommendation wire|keep_public|retire (never safe_to_delete). Default scope_mode=task_neighborhood after replace/retire; optional project_scan for ranked discovery (prefer path_prefix to scope a package); optional disk_search/coverage_hits/flag_states/triage. Astloom never deletes files — prove then delete locally. Anchors required except project_scan. Prefer min_confidence=0.8 before safe deletes. Graph is SoT — do not treat Memory as a candidate queue.

project_id.description: Optional; must match active MCP project scope when set

anchor_symbols.description: Symbol ids, qualified names, or short names in the change neighborhood

anchor_paths.description: Repo-relative path prefixes for explicit_paths / anchors

path_prefix.description: Optional repo-relative directory/file prefix; report candidates only under this path while liveness still uses the full project graph

min_confidence.description: Minimum numeric score to include; use 0.8 when acting on safe_to_delete

triage.description: Advisory triage (local rules; optional LLM judge later); cannot raise safe_to_delete

disk_search.description: Optional bounded disk string-name search (requires repo_root); soft-blocks safe_to_delete

repo_root.description: Absolute or workspace root for optional disk_search

coverage_hits.description: Optional map symbol_id→hit_count; hits>0 block delete; 0 is evidence only

flag_states.description: Optional feature-flag states for flag_controlled_dead findings (constant_for_days>=90)

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_path
tools.description: Shortest path between two symbols (ids or qualified names) on the code graph.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_freshness
tools.description: Report or mark pending file sync (stale banners for explore/review).

file_path.description: If set, mark this path pending until next ingest

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_ide_references
tools.description: IDE-semantic find-references via local Language Server (reference_kind=ide_semantic). Does NOT write durable CODE_REL. Prefer astloom_code_graph_neighbors for structural graph edges.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_ide_definition
tools.description: IDE-semantic go-to-definition via local Language Server (reference_kind=ide_semantic). Not a durable graph edge lookup.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_ide_rename
tools.description: IDE-semantic rename via local Language Server, then AST reconcile_after_edit (reference_kind=ide_semantic). Never dual-writes CODE_REL from LSP.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_reconcile_after_edit
tools.description: After IDE/LSP edits: mark paths pending and optionally AST re-ingest (reference_kind=structural converge). ADR 48 one-way reconcile.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_generation_context
tools.description: Build a generation context pack for coding agents: seed symbol, related symbols, and hybrid_documentation layers (human → living → rationale → AST). Prefer human docs when DOCUMENTED_BY exists; never invents edges.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_ingest_file
tools.description: Index one source file into the code-knowledge graph (symbols, edges, docs). Use to populate Neo4j from the IDE.

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_ingest_repo
tools.description: Walk a local repository root and index all supported source files into the code-knowledge graph (Python/TS/JS/Go/Rust). Skips node_modules/.git/.venv/etc. Prefer astloom_code_graph_sync for normal use.

root_path.description: Absolute or expandable path to the repository root

include_extensions.description: Optional extension allow-list (e.g. [".py", ".ts"]); default = language matrix

exclude_dirs.description: Directory names to skip (default includes node_modules, .git, .venv, …)

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_sync
tools.description: Sync a repository into the code graph. File mode is chosen automatically (full vs incremental). Optional embedding_refresh_mode=full matches CLI `astloom sync heal` (whole-scope missing/mismatch + orphans); default touched scopes embeddings to this run.

embedding_refresh_mode.description: touched = embeddings for files this run (noop capped backlog). full = uncapped project heal (CLI: astloom sync heal).

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_purge
tools.description: Wipe all graph data for the current project scope. Requires confirm=true. Run sync afterward to rebuild.

confirm.description: Must be true to execute the wipe

tools.name: astloom_backup_status
tools.description: Return the last local project backup/restore job summary (no bundle transfer).

tools.name: astloom_backup_dry_run
tools.description: Validate a server-local .asbak path and report conflict/remap outcome without writing. Large bundles stay on disk — use CLI for export/restore.

bundle_path.description: Absolute path to a .asbak file on the Astloom server host

replace.description: If true, dry-run assumes --replace wipe policy

tools.name: astloom_code_graph_language_profile
tools.description: Return polyglot language/profile stats for symbols currently in the project graph.

tools.name: astloom_create_task
tools.description: Create a durable Task record for follow-up engineering work.

tools.name: astloom_quality_audit
tools.description: Categorized docs+code quality findings (standards, size, linking, revision, never-ingested/stale code). Call at session start and after material edits. Returns summary, top findings with fix_hint, and must_remediate. Optional create_tasks writes durable CoreData tasks for high/medium findings (stable fingerprints). create_tasks implies reconcile_tasks; set reconcile_tasks alone to cancel cleared mcp-quality Tasks and purge terminal ones past retention.

create_tasks.description: If true, create durable automated follow-up Tasks for high/medium findings (implies reconcile_tasks)

reconcile_tasks.description: Cancel open mcp-quality automated Tasks whose fingerprint is no longer in the active finding set; purge terminal automated Tasks older than ASTLOOM_FOLLOWUP_TASK_RETENTION_DAYS. Implied when create_tasks is true.

tools.name: astloom_write
tools.description: Write durable Astloom records from Cursor: memory notes, tasks, activity, or decisions for the scoped project.

body.description: Full text body (memory) or decision statement

tools.name: astloom_docs_drift_check
tools.description: Request a documentation drift check for changed symbols (docs-sync capability).

tools.name: astloom_docs_stale_candidates
tools.description: Scored stale-documentation candidates (orphan_doc/ghost_link/stale_anchor/superseded_retrieval_risk/wiki_orphan/duplicate_authority; optional coverage_gap). Default scope_mode=task_neighborhood; optional project_scan with path_prefix. Prefer safe_to_update/safe_to_unlink over safe_to_delete; act only when score>=0.8 and blockers empty. wiki_orphan and duplicate_authority never auto-delete. Astloom never deletes Markdown. Graph/docs registry are SoT — not Memory.

project_id.description: Optional; must match active MCP project scope when set

anchor_symbols.description: Symbol ids or paths in the change neighborhood

path_prefix.description: Optional docs-root relative prefix; report candidates only under this path

min_confidence.description: Minimum score; use 0.8 for destructive remediations; project_scan omit→0.50

triage.description: Advisory triage; cannot raise act flags

include_coverage_gaps.description: Opt-in missing human-doc findings for doc_required symbols

tools.name: astloom_docs_write
tools.description: Documentation workflow from Cursor: Body-tier validate frontmatter, index a doc note, or create a review draft for a symbol via docs-sync. For Full-tier product Markdown rules call astloom_docs_authoring_standards first.

mode.description: validate=check frontmatter only; note/index=index a document; draft=create documentation draft for a symbol

symbol.description: Symbol path for draft/note linking (e.g. auth.hash_password)

file_path.description: Source file path for the symbol

path.description: Logical docs path for note/index (e.g. docs/modules/auth.md)

frontmatter.description: Optional full frontmatter object (validate/index). When set, overrides generated fields.

tools.name: astloom_docs_status
tools.description: Return documentation coverage and missing-doc gaps for the scoped project (docs-as-code sync). For Full-tier product Markdown authoring rules, call astloom_docs_authoring_standards.

tools.name: astloom_docs_authoring_standards
tools.description: Return Full-tier Astloom documentation authoring law: required frontmatter, lanes, Mermaid+flow tables, size budgets, procedure 10, and CLI gates. Call when the user asks how documentation works or before writing/remediating product Markdown under docs/. Docs-sync validate is Body-tier only.

tools.name: astloom_docs_catalog
tools.description: Cached documentation catalog built from this software's scanned Markdown frontmatter. Vocabularies (tags/lanes/doc_type/…) are observed — not a global hardcoded enum. Use filters to narrow which paths to Read. Does not invent DOCUMENTED_BY. Optional refresh/roots rebuild the cache.

roots.description: Optional doc roots to scan (product-specific). Omit to use ASTLOOM_DOCS_CATALOG_ROOTS or defaults.

tag.description: Filter by frontmatter tag observed in this software

has_linked_symbols.description: If set, only docs with or without linked_symbols

tools.name: astloom_guidance_resolve
tools.description: Resolve Agent Workspace Guidance for this project: AGENTS entry, always-on rules, and skill catalog. Prefer calling before substantive coding. Seeds MCP-first guidance when empty.

task_summary.description: Optional task summary for applicability scoring

include_skill_bodies.description: If true, include skill bodies in the catalog (prefer get_skill instead)

tools.name: astloom_guidance_list_skills
tools.description: List Astloom skill catalog descriptors without always-on rule bodies.

tools.name: astloom_guidance_get_skill
tools.description: Fetch one Agent Workspace Guidance skill body by skill_id or name.

bundle_id.description: Optional correlation to a prior guidance resolve
